bounded_live_debug_activity.notes: Yandex requests include failed worker runs used to expose and reproduce the Windows stdout bug. Each run had one robots fetch and one search-page fetch. Card verification stopped at the first HTTP 403; other candidates were not opened. No retries, redirects, API endpoints, CAPTCHA handling, or proxy rotation were used.

root_cause_and_fix.cause: Scrapy runs under Python isolated mode on Windows, where stdout used CP1251 despite PYTHONUTF8. A live HTML title containing U+2033 caused UnicodeEncodeError during JSON output, so Node saw a failed worker.
root_cause_and_fix.fix: The worker now serializes protocol output as UTF-8 bytes through sys.stdout.buffer; a regression test covers Russian text and U+2033.

interpretation: HTML discovery is operational for Yandex Market. The observed listing prices are discovery-only and are not verified current prices. Yandex product-card access is blocked; Ozon and Wildberries did not pass the fail-closed robots check; Avito was deliberately not retried. No marketplace currently produced a VERIFIED offer.
